intro: Today is the final day for both SWELL Sculpture Festival along Currumbin Beach and Mamma Mia! at The Star — if you haven’t been, this morning or afternoon is the last chance. Through to the 26th, Kids Take Over brings a school-holiday spectacle to HOTA and Brisbane Festival 2026 continues its three-week run of theatre and music across South Bank. Anastasia The Musical has just opened at QPAC and runs through October — a beautiful excuse for a Brisbane evening. On the horizon: BLEACH* opens 1 October with Lady Blackbird headlining a free show on the HOTA outdoor stage, followed by Groundwater Country Music on free Broadbeach stages 16–18 October.
topPicksTitle: Top Things To Do This Week (20–27 Sep)

topPicks.date: Final day — Sunday 20 September · Currumbin Beach
topPicks.name: SWELL Sculpture Festival
topPicks.desc: The Gold Coast's most-loved outdoor gallery closes today — 100+ large-scale sculptures along Currumbin's sand with twilight walks and artist talks. Free, iconic, last chance.

topPicks.date: Final day — Sunday 20 September · The Star, Broadbeach
topPicks.name: Mamma Mia! The Musical
topPicks.desc: The Gold Coast season of ABBA's greatest musical closes tonight. A lavish feel-good show — Dancing Queen, dazzling cast, last performance this evening.

topPicks.name: Kids Take Over Festival
topPicks.desc: Spring school holidays and a space-themed extravaganza at HOTA — Erth's Dinosaurs, the Hot Potato Band, a Galactic Space Wall by 1,000 local students, workshops and free daily activities.

topPicks.name: Brisbane Festival 2026
topPicks.desc: Three weeks of theatre, music and riverside spectacle across South Bank and beyond. The final week is often the best — worth planning a day trip around a headline act.

events.date: Final day — Sunday 20 September · Currumbin Beach
events.name: SWELL Sculpture Festival
events.desc: The Gold Coast's most-loved outdoor gallery — large-scale sculptures along Currumbin's sand at sunrise, sunset and everything between. Free, iconic, last day today.

events.date: Final day — Sunday 20 September · The Star, Gold Coast
events.name: Mamma Mia! The Musical
events.desc: 25 years of ABBA magic — feel-good story, dazzling cast, Dancing Queen. Final performance tonight at The Star Broadbeach.
events.location: The Star Gold Coast, Broadbeach · 15 min drive

events.name: Kids Take Over Festival
events.desc: Spring school holidays launch a space-themed extravaganza at HOTA — Erth's life-like Dinosaurs, the Hot Potato Band, a Galactic Space Wall by 1,000 local students, workshops and free daily activities.

events.name: Brisbane Festival 2026
events.desc: The city's biggest celebration of art and community — three weeks of theatre, music, dance and riverside spectacle across South Bank and beyond. Worth planning a day trip around.
events.location: South Bank & citywide, Brisbane · 75 min drive

events.name: This Moment — Dining at Palette
events.desc: HOTA's This Moment exhibition spills into Palette restaurant — art-inspired dining where the menu answers the gallery. A refined long lunch, ten minutes from the villa.

events.name: Anastasia The Musical
events.desc: The sweeping Broadway musical journeys from the twilight of the Russian Empire to 1920s Paris — lavish, romantic and made for a special night out.

events.name: Lady Blackbird & Electric Fields
events.desc: BLEACH Festival opens with a free double bill on HOTA's Outdoor Stage — internationally acclaimed jazz-soul singer Lady Blackbird headlines alongside Electric Fields, whose Zaachariaha Fielding sings in the traditional language of the Anangu People. Free tickets required.
events.location: HOTA Outdoor Stage, Surfers Paradise · 10 min drive

events.name: BLEACH Festival 2026
events.desc: The Gold Coast's signature arts festival returns — eleven days of live music, theatre and large-scale spectacle at HOTA and across the city, headlined by Six60. The Coast at its most alive.

events.name: Groundwater Country Music Festival
events.desc: Free three-day country music celebration across Broadbeach — Kasey Chambers, Kaylee Bell, The Wolfe Brothers and 30+ acts on outdoor stages. No tickets, no fuss, just great music in the sun.
